steps.title: 4 simple steps to get started with Mboa

signup.title: Sign-up
signup.text: You describe your business and the account owner. Five minutes is enough.

verify.title: Verification
verify.text: You confirm your email address with the code you receive, then access your partner space.

review.title: Review
review.text: You upload your documents online; our team reviews them within 48 hours, excluding weekends.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: Your business goes live, or your riders receive their first jobs.

cost.a: Yes, signing up is free. Commercial terms (commission, payout schedule) are presented by an advisor when your application is reviewed.

documents.a: For a restaurant: RCCM, NIU, the manager's ID, a location map (or a photo of the storefront) and the operating licence. For a delivery company: RCCM, NIU, the manager's ID and the vehicle insurance certificate; your riders are then added in the fleet panel once your application is approved. You upload the documents in your partner space right after signing up.

riders.q: How do my riders join Mboa?
riders.a: Once your company is approved, you add your riders in the fleet panel, one by one or with an Excel file. Each receives an invitation code, downloads the Mboa Delivery app and finishes signing up.

cities.q: Which cities is Mboa available in?
cities.a: Mboa is launching in the Republic of Congo. You can sign up from any city: an advisor will tell you when the service opens in your area.

code.q: I didn't receive the verification code.
code.a: The code is sent to the email address you entered. Check your spam folder, wait a minute, then use “Resend code”. You can also log in later: a new code will be sent to you.

closing.text: Five minutes to sign up, then an advisor supports you all the way to launch.

shell.time_text: You will then upload your official documents (RCCM, NIU, ID…) in your partner space.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Mboa Delivery collects when you register your restaurant, shop or delivery company on this site, why we use it and how you stay in control of it.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.text: Mboa Delivery, an ordering and delivery platform operating in the Republic of Congo, is responsible for the data collected on this site. For any question: {{email}}.

data.title: The data we collect
data.text: Only what you enter in the signup form, plus a few technical data needed for security:
items: Your business: trading name, type of business, company name, RCCM and NIU if provided.
Your contact details: phone, email (optional), address and city.
The GPS location of your business, only if you allow it or enter it.
The name of the manager or account owner.
Your password: it is sent encrypted to our server and never stored in plain text by this site.
Technical data: IP address, kept in pseudonymised form in security logs.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.text: Your data is only used to:
items: verify your email address with a verification code;
review your application and contact you about your signup;
calculate distances and delivery areas for your business;
protect the site against abuse (attempt limits, bot detection).

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Processing is based on your consent, given by ticking the box in the form, and on the steps needed to set up our partnership at your request.

recipients.title: Who can access it
recipients.text: Only the Mboa teams in charge of partners and support can access it, along with our technical providers (hosting, sending verification codes) within the limits of their task. We never sell or rent your data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: Signup data is kept while your application is reviewed and then for the whole duration of the partnership. If your application does not go ahead, it is deleted within a reasonable time, unless the law requires us to keep it. Security logs are kept for a short period.

security.title: How we protect it
security.text: Traffic is encrypted (HTTPS), passwords must be strong, attempts are limited and sensitive information is masked in our logs.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This site uses a single cookie, “app_language”, which remembers the language you chose. There are no advertising cookies and no analytics tools.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under Congolese law no. 29-2019 of 10 October 2019 on the protection of personal data, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. Write to us at {{email}}.
